## How to run

- Progress dashboard: `node scripts/progress.mjs`
- Typecheck: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.helix.json`
- Focused test: `cd packages/engine && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test --test-concurrency=1 test/<file>.test.ts`
- Full engine suite (once per session, right before SESSION SUMMARY; ~5–8 min, timeout ≥ 600 s): same command with `"test/**/*.test.ts"` (`pnpm test` can hang in the v0 VM)
- CLI tests: `pnpm --filter @helix/cli test`
- Workbench (service `helix-workbench`, port 4100): `bash -lc "set -a; . ./.env.development.local; set +a; exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning packages/engine/src/main.ts --ws 4100 --ui --host 0.0.0.0 --allow-host '*' --no-auth"`
- Desktop: `pnpm --filter @helix/desktop setup` (fetch Electron), test `cd packages/desktop && node --test test/desktop.test.mjs`
- Live model: env `GEMINI_API`, model `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (free tier ~20 req/day per model)

## Environment notes

- No Docker. Rootless Podman is installable: `sudo dnf install -y podman crun bubblewrap` (none persist across VM resets; reinstall before sandbox tests; bwrap is the `local-os` backend). Then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (snapshot node_modules can lag the lockfile). runc cannot mask /proc here, so the probe picks crun with masked /proc.
- Podman "boot ID differs" / "cannot re-exec ... user namespace": state left over from a previous boot. Check `podman ps -a` and `ls ~/.local/share/containers` first, and never delete storage blindly. A fully reset VM has no state, and a fresh install works.
- `unshare` works; no cgroups; /proc cannot be mounted in a user namespace (locked /proc overmounts); runsc download 404s.
